main_text.p: ras propenso meremur. Voto finiam, quo Legum istarum opus cum in scri-pta referret Solo, auspicatus est,
Θεσμοῖς [?] τοῖσδε [?] πόλιν ἀγαθὴν καὶ κῶδας ὁπάσαι [?].
Admonendus est Lector, in hac Legum Sylloge, illas, quæ in Commen-tario uncialibus literis scribuntur, asterisco notari: Si qua autem irrepserunt sphalmata, iis offendi ne velit, rogatur.
main_text.head: SUMMA PRIVILEGII.
main_text.p: CAUTUM est authoritate Regia ne quis in regno Franciæ, librum cui titulus est, Leges Atticæ, Samuel Petitus collegit, digessit, & commentario illustrauit, absque Caroli Morelli Typographi Regij & Bibliopolæ Parisien-sis permissu intra septennium imprimat aut diuendat: publicationis siquis se-cus fecerit, mulcta mille librarum vindicabitur, prout in ipso diplomate continetur, Dato Lutetiæ Parisiorum die trigesimo primo Decembris, anno M. DC. XXXIV.

page.notes: The Greek lines are small and partly unclear; the marked words are doubtful readings. The first word of the page is a fragment ("ras") and is kept as printed. The large initial C is joined to "AVTVM" as "CAUTUM". The ornamental rule and the two horizontal rules are not text. The long s is written as plain s throughout. No page number, running head or catchword is printed.
